description: List a signed-in athlete's completed and planned workout rows over a rolling window (`days`) or on a single calendar `date`, without profile or volume synthesis. Use to inspect training logs or check one day's schedule; for full coaching readiness with ACWR and 17-muscle volume use `get_coaching_brief`, or use `log_workout` / `plan_workout` to write sessions. Requires `read` scope.

date.description: Optional single ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) to filter exact day entries.

days.description: Rolling lookback/lookahead window in days (1–90). Ignored when `date` is provided.

focus.description: Concise 1-sentence summary of what the athlete is asking in this turn (e.g. 'building a 4-day powerlifting block', 'checking squat progression', 'auditing weekly back volume') so STRUGGL ranks relevant athlete memories and context.

name: get_sessions

sessions.description: Chronological completed and planned exercise rows with sets, reps, load, RPE, or endurance metrics.

title: List Training Sessions
